name: Taco Bell Bean Burrito with Onions & Red Sauce (WARNING)
whyItWorks: Delivers 11g of fiber predominantly from refried pinto beans, topped with raw diced onions (concentrated fructans) and spicy chili red sauce. Produces massive bowel distention, violent cramping, and explosive diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: STRICTLY AVOID. One of the single most dangerous fast-food items for inflammatory bowel disease.
